text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, how was that! I pulled off a 
brilliant victory, didn't I!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"I managed to keep Flower-san completely 
in check, so with this, my growth—"
choice_data_list: Congrats!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Whoa-whoa!?
choice_data_list: You did an amazing job!!
You did an amazing job!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes. I'm doing very well myself, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What's gotten into you? You seem way more 
energetic than usual.
choice_data_list: Back-to-back Sprinters Stakes victories!
You've won back-to-back Sprinters Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh...? Ooh!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, you finished in 1st 
place in this race last year too, didn't 
you!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see, back-to-back victories... And in a 
GⅠ race, no less!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This is indeed a remarkable achievement! 
Your classmates will surely be thrilled as 
well!
choice_data_list: That's incredible!
That's an amazing thing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes!! I am an amazing Class Rep!
choice_data_list: I knew you could do it!
I knew you could do it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Trust and the class rep go hand 
in hand!
choice_data_list: That's really amazing! As expected!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's amazing... but! Um, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I'm the greatest Uma Musume in the world!

I'm the number one Uma Musume in the 
world!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um, that is true, but... Well, aren't 
you praising me a bit too much?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Even though I am accustomed to receiving 
praise, this feels a little embarrassing, 
to be honest.
choice_data_list: I haven't praised you nearly enough!
I haven't praised you nearly enough yet!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Y-You want to praise me even more?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Understood!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Then I shall steel my resolve too! And 
receive heaps of praise!
choice_data_list: You're a speed genius!
You're a genius of speed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes!! I am a genius!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Next, please!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And right next to where the 
1,000-compliment drill had begun...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
“—Thank you for the point! Next one, 
please!”

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...What are Bakushin O-san and the others 
doing, I wonder...?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I came to say congratulations, but... 
Would later be better?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Just between us... congratulations on your 
back-to-back victory, Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: *gasp*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"I think I can keep running freely for a 
while longer, even without any praise!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, next time you might even be 
in too good of a condition!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Our next race. After leaving behind such 
an amazing result, I'm sure she'll...!"
choice_data_list: Then let's take on the 1,600m next!
Then let's take on the 1,600m next!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huh? Another 1200—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, really!? If it's 1600m, that 
means...!
choice_data_list: We're heading into the Mile CS!
Let's head into the Mile CS!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's 400 meters longer than her 
specialized 1200m distance, but... With 
who she is now, she can definitely win!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ooooooh...! Finally, taking the stage at 
the mile!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's wonderful!! I'm just as happy as when 
we won back-to-back victories!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: All right, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
—The title of Mile Champion will be mine 
as well!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the next target race was decided: 
the Mile Championship!
